text:
evan: Short thread to lock GA acceptance items. Open: SLA numbers + credit calc, canary/rollout gating, pricing-tier mapping, docs quickstart, runbook owner, telemetry retention, and support shadow week. Who takes what?

nora: I can own the runbook + customer comms. Will include escalation chain and canned emails.

felix: I'll draft the SLA table. Proposal: hosted standard p95 <200ms, streaming p95 <500ms, error rate <0.5%. Monthly credit scheme, cap 40%.

rachel: I'll do the docs quickstart and include a short rate-limit FAQ and streaming note. Need a demo token from eng to embed.

evan: Canary plan: three rings over 72h (internal -> beta -> public) with a manual gate before public. Auto rollback if 30m burn >2% error budget.

nora: Support: require 1-week shadow for Dedicated customers; optional for self-serve. I'll draft L1/L2 scripts.

felix: Telemetry: Ops prefers 14-day default, 90-day for paid tiers. ops-bot, can you post cost delta?

ops-bot: telemetry-cost: 14d ~= $2.9k/mo per 100k reqs; 90d ~= $7.2k/mo per 100k reqs (est).

rachel: Docs ETA: 2024-07-05 if eng provides demo by 2024-06-30.

felix: SLA doc ETA: 2024-06-25 EOD. Will include streaming vs non-streaming rows and credit examples.

nora: Runbook + comms ETA: 2024-06-27 COB.

evan: I'll convert into tickets with acceptance criteria (SLA doc shows calc, docs include working snippet, runbook has escalation). If anyone objects to deadlines, flag now.

rachel: Sounds good. I'll ask eng for a short-lived demo endpoint.

felix: One more: commercial asked for an "Enterprise Plus" appendix for customers needing 99.99% availability. We'll document extra commitments but not GA-enable it.

evan: Agreed. Thanks team — keeping this tight so PM review can go tomorrow.
